explain.say: Look under a stone in a garden. You may find lots of small creatures. They are called minibeasts. Which ones are insects? Count their legs to find out. Look at the board. It sorts minibeasts by their legs.

explain.say: Look at the Six legs group. Every insect has 6 legs. There are 3 legs on each side. Ants, bees, butterflies, ladybirds and grasshoppers all have 6 legs. Count the legs on the next ant you see.

explain.say: Look at this insect up close. The middle part is the thorax. All 6 legs join on here. The wings join here too. An insect has 3 parts: head, thorax and abdomen. The head has feelers called antennae.

explain.say: Now look at the Eight legs group. A spider has 8 legs. It has 2 body parts and no feelers. So a spider is not an insect. Scorpions and ticks have 8 legs too.

faq.q: How many legs does an insect have?
faq.a: Every adult insect has six legs, three on each side of its middle part, the thorax.
asks: Do all insects have six legs?

faq.a: No. A spider has eight legs, two body parts and no antennae. It belongs to a group called arachnids, with scorpions and ticks.
asks: Why is a spider not an insect?

faq.q: What are the three parts of an insect?
faq.a: An insect has a head with eyes, mouth and antennae, a thorax where the legs and wings join, and an abdomen at the back for digesting food and laying eggs.
No. A centipede has one pair of legs on each body section, so it has far more than six. Millipedes have two pairs per section.
asks: How many legs does a centipede have?

faq.a: Antennae are feelers on an insect's head. They smell, taste and touch, helping the insect find food and friends.

facts: All adult insects have six legs and three body parts: head, thorax and abdomen.
In 2021 a millipede named Eumillipes persephone with 1306 legs was described from Western Australia.

quiz.show: A minibeast has 8 legs. What could it be?
quiz.why: A spider has 8 legs. Insects, like bees and ladybirds, have 6 legs.

wrong.1: A bee is an insect. It has 6 legs.
wrong.2: A ladybird is an insect. It has 6 legs.

quiz.say: Look at the insect. Which part do its 6 legs join?
quiz.show: Which part do the 6 legs join?
quiz.why: All 6 legs join the thorax, the middle part. The wings join there too.
